## Why join?

Membership in the SAA is open to everyone interested in sequence analysis and related methods — researchers, teachers, students and practitioners. As a member you

::: {.icon-list}
- []{.bi .bi-check2-square} have the right to vote at the SAA **General Assembly** (see the [statutes](statutes.qmd)),
- []{.bi .bi-envelope-paper} receive the **newsletter** with news about SAA activities, webinars and events,
- []{.bi .bi-people} help shape the association's events, webinars and training activities.
:::

## How to join

::: {.icon-list}
- []{.bi .bi-1-circle} Read the [SAA statutes](statutes.qmd) — they describe the structure, purposes and functioning of the association.
- []{.bi .bi-2-circle} Fill in the membership request form below. Please tell us briefly about your interest in sequence analysis.
- []{.bi .bi-3-circle} The Executive Committee reviews your request; this may take a few days. You will receive an email once it has been approved.
:::

## Data protection
The form is provided by [Tally](https://tally.so). The information you enter is used only to process your membership request and to contact you about SAA activities. Details are in our [privacy policy](privacy.qmd); questions to [info@sequenceanalysis.org](mailto:info@sequenceanalysis.org).
:::
